verdict.rationale: Docs confirm client vs server SDK distinction, deterministic cross-platform evaluation, and a quickstart showing React (StatsigProvider) plus JS SDK usage in-browser, implying consistent flag behavior across platforms. However, there's no explicit enumeration of a full SDK matrix (specific backend languages, iOS/Android/React Native mobile SDKs) or independent confirmation of consistency across all of them. missing for 10: explicit list/documentation of backend language SDKs, mobile (iOS/Android/React Native) SDK docs, and independent/hands-on verification of consistent behavior across the full stack.
